source.title: OpenStreetMap · Washington Square peripheral buildings and alley
source.notes: Reused the retained bounded extraction captured 2026-11-16T03:24:27.930514+00:00; no new acquisition. Snapshot timestamp was not supplied. Normalized source SHA-256 d2fdecb087ca53305f03f93e4a8ca776916762fcfa0ffc5a9c07543384d8b423. Added 24 non-overlapping peripheral building footprints and two Via Ferlinghetti segments, compared with retained 2022 NOAA and 2024 NAIP imagery. Existing interpreted objects remain unchanged. Source heights, inferred dimensions and authored colors have independent evidence. See docs/SURVEY_AUDIT.md and /reference/washington-square-edge-audit.json. ODbL terms: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/.
